Implemented VLQ encoding and decoding in [variable-length-quantity.js](/app/variable-length-quantity.js).

- Supports unsigned 32-bit integers, including `0xffffffff`
- Encodes multiple values into one byte stream
- Decodes concatenated VLQ sequences
- Throws `Error('Incomplete sequence')` for unterminated input
- Uses arithmetic grouping to avoid signed 32-bit bitwise overflow
